```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)

```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

```{r}
generate_data <- function(n, cost_ratio) {
  
  # Simulate parameters
  expert_fee <- 165 #cost at decision node
  
  cma_cost <- rgamma(n, 2010,2.44) # cost of CMA
  cma_yield <- rbeta(n, 154,1382) # CMA yield
  
  #wes_cost <- rnorm(n, 4589.4, 45) #cost of WES
  wes_yield_1tier <- rbeta(n, 27, 46)  # WES first-tier yield (mean 0.37)
  wes_yield_3tier <- rbeta(n, 228, 464) # WES third-tier yield (mean 0.33)
  wes_yield_2tier <- 0.35 # The yield of WES as second-tier test is slightly lower than first-tier but higher than third-tier
  
  gp_cost <- rnorm(n, 1000, 30)  # gene-panel cost
  wes_cost <- gp_cost*cost_ratio
  gp_yield <- rbeta(n, 234, 1871)  # gene-panel yield
  
  # AI precision, assume that it follows a beta distribution with mean 0.87 & SD 0.1
  mu <- 0.87
  sigma <- 0.15
  alpha <- mu * ((mu * (1 - mu) / sigma^2) - 1)
  beta <- (1 - mu) * ((mu * (1 - mu) / sigma^2) - 1)
  ai_precision <- rbeta(n,alpha,beta)  #AI precision
  
  # Expected cost for Scenario 1 (CMA + GP, standard testing)
  s1_cost <- cma_cost + expert_fee + (1-cma_yield)*(gp_cost + expert_fee) 
  
  # Expected cost for Scenario 2 (CMA + GP + WES)
  s2_cost <- cma_cost + expert_fee + (1-cma_yield)*(gp_cost + expert_fee + (1-gp_yield)*(wes_cost + expert_fee))
  
  # Expected cost Scenario 3 (CMA + WES)
  s3_cost <- cma_cost + expert_fee + (1-cma_yield)*(wes_cost + expert_fee) 
                    
  # Expected cost for Scenario 4 (WES alone)
  s4_cost <- wes_cost + expert_fee
  
  # AI-delegation cost
  ai1_cost <- cma_cost + expert_fee + (1-cma_yield)*(gp_cost + (1-ai_precision)*wes_cost) #This is only for r > r*
  
  ai2_cost <- s3_cost #r < r*, the expected cost is the same as CMA + WES (scenario 3)
  
  # Expected effectiveness of scenario 1
  s1_eff <- gp_yield
  
  # Expected effectiveness of scenario 2
  s2_eff <- wes_yield_3tier
  
  # Expected effectiveness of scenario 3
  s3_eff <- rep(wes_yield_2tier,n)
  
  # Expected effectiveness of scenario 4
  s4_eff <- wes_yield_1tier
  
  # Expected effectiveness of AI-delegation mode
  ai_eff <- ai_precision + wes_yield_2tier*(1 - ai_precision)
  
  data <- data.frame(
    expected_cost = c(s1_cost, s2_cost, s3_cost, s4_cost, ai1_cost),
    expected_effectiveness = c(s1_eff, s2_eff, s3_eff, s4_eff, ai_eff),
    ai_performance = rep(ai_precision,5),
    cost_diff = rep(cost_ratio,5),
    scenario = rep(c("CMA + GP", "CMA + GP + WES", "CMA + WES", "WES alone","AI-Delegation"), each = n)
  )

  data$scenario <- factor(data$scenario, levels = c("CMA + GP", "CMA + GP + WES", "CMA + WES", "WES alone", "AI-Delegation"))
  return(data)
}
```

```{r}
create_plot <- function(data, title) {
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = ai_performance, y = expected_cost, color = scenario)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = title, x = "AI Precision", y = "Expected Cost") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "green", "red", "black", "purple")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_blank())
}


```

```{r}
cost_ratio_1 <- generate_data(200,5)
cost_ratio_2 <- generate_data(200,3)
cost_ratio_3 <- generate_data(200,1.5)
```

```{r}
plot1 <- create_plot(cost_ratio_1, "Cost Ratio = 5")
plot2 <- create_plot(cost_ratio_2, "Cost Ratio = 3")
plot3 <- create_plot(cost_ratio_3, "Cost Ratio = 1.5")
plot1
plot2
plot3
```

```{r}
plot_grid(plot1, plot2, plot3, ncol = 1)
```
